body:
Extend the independent efficiency audit with the retained TypeSafe research and concrete System One experiments for preparing coding-agent context.

Deliverables:
- Read the complete retained TypeSafe corpus and map its theories to isolated, measurable briefing components.
- Cover syntax/AST traversal, dependency and test discovery, Git history, typed semantic selection, deterministic packing, caching, and incremental refresh.
- Add a runnable read-only issue-briefing preview prototype with explicit acquisition and assembly timings, preserving the original issue and evidence provenance.
- Document the conditions for a subsecond local preview and how to compare component quality, latency, and downstream success independently.
- Targeted verification, commit, and push to main.

This work is separate from the active production routing and standing efficiency-study issues. The prototype does not alter agent execution or deployment.
title: System One briefing audit and runnable issue preview prototype
